scope: Three independent sources, a resave baseline and eight actual axis edits per source, with pinned fonts and official XSD/OPC. Source anchors and native producer geometry are recorded separately. Excel/WPS runtime unverified.
producerDifferences: Calc converts one-cell and absolute source containers to two-cell forms and rewrites transformed geometry/cache coordinates on resave; original native source anchors remain separate evidence.
Some first-open one-cell edits retain the old physical position in Calc. SDK movement follows the Microsoft oneCellAnchor source contract, which moves with its cell and retains physical extents.

Calc may retain a classic box size on an internal row deletion despite SizeWithCells. SDK applies both moving/resizing markers when both source flags are true; native observations are not replaced with SDK expectations.
